items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: And Ellick was a light drummer, you know. People would be dancing out in the street and they'd come inside, you know, and say, them three fellas there making that music

ctx.x: Yeah, they play as well. Dolly plays piano, you know, she's swell piano. And she play bass violin too. Lawrence play piano, she play the bass. Lawrence is the cornet player and the trombone player. Donnie lived right around the block. Right around. That's what worried in that little woman about there, about to get away from me. He was a nice trombone player. He worked with me when I was in the WPA band. He split the band in two. He wouldn't let me in that band. You know when they first got up, they had about two…
Yeah, he's a bishop now. He wears a big black gun.
